log_level.description: Log level for CUPS (e.g., warn, debug, info, error)

max_log_size.description: Maximum size of log files before rotation (e.g., 1m, 0 to disable)

listen_port.description: Port number for CUPS listener (used in Listen localhost:PORT)

browsing_enabled.description: Whether to show shared printers on the local network

web_interface_enabled.description: Whether to enable the web interface

idle_exit_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which cupsd exits if idle (0 disables)
